name: INSDC BioProject, BioSample and SRA metadata as RDF
description: RDF conversion of the NCBI BioProject, BioSample and SRA metadata dumps of 2026-11-13 (SRA experiment metadata NCBI_SRA_Metadata_Full_20261112), produced with insdc-rdf: 61,338,958 BioSample, 1,138,378 BioProject, 145,844,632 SRA accession and 42,541,561 SRA experiment records as 5,833,016,093 N-Triples lines (5,742,848,281 distinct triples), in N-Triples, Turtle and JSON-LD. The bsllmner-mk2 annotation RDF attaches to the BioSample IRIs of this release.

software.name: insdc-rdf
software.description: Converts INSDC metadata dumps (BioSample, BioProject, SRA) and bsllmner-mk2 releases to RDF.

intro: This release is the RDF form of the NCBI BioProject, BioSample and SRA metadata dumps, converted with [insdc-rdf](https://github.com/inutano/insdc-rdf). The BioSample model follows the curated schema at <https://github.com/inutano/biosample_jsonld>.

The bsllmner-mk2 annotation RDF, release `2026-10_qwen3.8-27b_rdf` in this bucket, attaches ontology-mapped annotations to the BioSample IRIs of this release. Load both into one graph to query them together.
notes: `dra_ont:Experiment` subjects come from both `sra` (accession list) and `sra-experiment` (experiment XML); load both for the full set.
Every triple is in the default graph. The chunks of one source can be loaded in any order.
BioProject `dct:created` values are typed `xsd:date`. In `2026-10_insdc-rdf` they were typed `xsd:dateTime`.

The triple counts in this README and in the bucket catalog count N-Triples lines. 90,167,812 lines repeat a triple. 85,083,122 of them come from `sra` and `sra-experiment`, which both write the `rdf:type` and `dct:identifier` of each of the 42,541,561 experiments. The remaining 5,084,690 are statements that the source data repeat, such as an attribute a BioSample lists twice, whose `rdf:type`, `schema:name` and `schema:additionalProperty` triples then recur. A triplestore keeps one copy, so the release loads as 5,742,848,281 distinct triples. A JSON-LD parser returns a set of triples, so for chunks with repeats it counts fewer triples than the chunk has lines.
terms: The data are derived from NCBI BioProject, BioSample and SRA. NCBI places no restrictions on their use or distribution, but notes that original submitters may claim rights in portions of the data: <https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/>. See also the bucket's sources and licenses: <https://biosampleplus.s3.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/SOURCES.md>.
